# The Roman Company, phase 1 (design 3.8): Imperial Pillars, fiscal edicts, group fis_cmp (gen_r6_aui.py, hook).
# Phase 2: oe_cmp_buy, oe_cmp_protect; phase 3: oe_cmp_nationalise (both at the end of this file, same group).

oe_cmp_invest = { # 向商社注资
    type = internationalorganization
    show_message = no
    potential = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars scope:actor = { tag = BYZ } }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_cmp_allow_has oe_cmp_has = yes }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_cmp_allow_calm oe_cmp_calm = yes }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_cmp_allow_inv_gold gold >= oe_cmp_inv_need }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_cmp_allow_inv_cd oe_cmp_inv_ready = yes }
        }
    }
    automation_tick = never
    ai_tick = never
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = international_organization
        source = actor
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_international_organization"
        none_available_msg_key = "leave_international_organization_none"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars scope:actor = { tag = BYZ } }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:recipient = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
                scope:actor = { oe_cmp_can_invest = yes }
            }
            custom_tooltip = oe_cmp_invest_tt
            hidden_effect = {
                scope:actor = {
                    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_job value = 2 }
                    trigger_event_silently = oe_cmp.90
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

oe_cmp_buy = { # 置地
    type = internationalorganization
    show_message = no
    potential = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars scope:actor = { tag = BYZ } }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_cmp_allow_has oe_cmp_has = yes }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_cmp_allow_stage2 oe_cmp_stage2_on = yes }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_cmp_allow_calm oe_cmp_calm = yes }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_cmp_allow_req oe_cmp_req_none = yes }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_cmp_allow_tgt oe_cmp_any_tgt = yes }
        }
    }
    automation_tick = never
    ai_tick = never
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = international_organization
        source = actor
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_international_organization"
        none_available_msg_key = "leave_international_organization_none"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars scope:actor = { tag = BYZ } }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = location
        source = actor
        target_flag = target
        name = "oe_cmp_buy_select"
        none_available_msg_key = "oe_cmp_buy_none"
        column = { data = name }
        column = { data = population }
        interaction_source_list = {
            location:tana = { if = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = source } every_neighbor_location = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = source } }
            location:kaffa = { if = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = source } every_neighbor_location = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = source } }
            location:trebizond = { if = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = source } every_neighbor_location = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = source } }
            location:sinop = { if = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = source } every_neighbor_location = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = source } }
            location:varna = { if = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = source } every_neighbor_location = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = source } }
            location:chilia = { if = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = source } every_neighbor_location = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = source } }
            location:famagusta = { if = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = source } every_neighbor_location = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = source } }
            location:alexandria = { if = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = source } every_neighbor_location = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = source } }
            location:beirut = { if = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = source } every_neighbor_location = { limit = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes } add_to_list = source } }
        }
        only_color_selectable = yes
        map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
        visible = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:recipient = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
                scope:actor = { oe_cmp_can_buy = yes }
                exists = scope:target
                scope:target = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes }
            }
            custom_tooltip = oe_cmp_buy_tt
            hidden_effect = {
                scope:actor = {
                    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_pick_loc value = scope:target }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_job value = 17 }
                    trigger_event_silently = oe_cmp.90
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

oe_cmp_protect = { # 订保护约
    type = internationalorganization
    show_message = no
    potential = { exists = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars scope:actor = { tag = BYZ } }
    allow = {
        scope:actor = {
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_cmp_allow_has oe_cmp_has = yes }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_cmp_allow_stage2 oe_cmp_stage2_on = yes }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_cmp_allow_calm oe_cmp_calm = yes }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_cmp_allow_req oe_cmp_req_none = yes }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_cmp_allow_prot_n OR = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_prot_n } var:oe_cmp_prot_n < 3 } }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_cmp_allow_prot_fee has_variable = oe_cmp_fund var:oe_cmp_fund >= oe_cmp_prot_fee }
            custom_tooltip = { text = oe_cmp_allow_prot_who any_country = { oe_cmp_prot_new = yes } }
        }
    }
    automation_tick = never
    ai_tick = never
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = international_organization
        source = actor
        target_flag = recipient
        name = "choose_international_organization"
        none_available_msg_key = "leave_international_organization_none"
        column = { data = name }
        visible = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars scope:actor = { tag = BYZ } }
    }
    select_trigger = {
        looking_for_a = location
        source = actor
        target_flag = target
        name = "oe_cmp_protect_select"
        none_available_msg_key = "oe_cmp_protect_none"
        column = { data = name }
        column = { data = population }
        interaction_source_list = {
            every_country = { limit = { oe_cmp_prot_new = yes } capital ?= { add_to_list = source } }
        }
        only_color_selectable = yes
        map_color = define:NMapColors|MAP_COLOR_HIGH
        visible = { is_capital = yes owner ?= { oe_cmp_prot_new = yes } }
    }
    effect = {
        if = {
            limit = {
                scope:recipient = { this = international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars }
                scope:actor = { oe_cmp_can_protect = yes }
                exists = scope:target
                scope:target = { is_capital = yes owner ?= { oe_cmp_prot_new = yes } }
            }
            custom_tooltip = oe_cmp_protect_tt
            hidden_effect = {
                scope:actor = {
                    scope:target = { owner = { save_scope_as = oe_cmp_who0 } } set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_pick_who value = scope:oe_cmp_who0 }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_job value = 18 }
                    trigger_event_silently = oe_cmp.90
                }
            }
        }
    }
}
